description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RTX is hiring a Software Engineer I for its Test Solutions Engineering team. The role develops and integrates Windows-based software applications and systems, supports testing and troubleshooting, and contributes across the engineering lifecycle for aerospace and defense products.
Software Engineer I developing C# and C++ test solutions, deriving requirements, and debugging software applications and systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop and integrate object-oriented software applications using C# and C++ in Microsoft Visual Studio
• Troubleshoot and debug software to ensure functionality and reliability
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop and implement solutions
• Work within established software development lifecycles, including Agile and Waterfall methodologies
• Develop and derive requirements for software applications and systems

Requirements:
• Active and transferable U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Ability to obtain INTERIM U.S. government issued security clearance is required prior to start date
• Bachelor's Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) obtained prior to start
• Experience with software development, testing, or integration using C, C++, Python, or Visual Basic
• Experience with Windows Operating Systems and Microsoft Visual Studio

Preferred:
• Basic understanding of software development principles and object-oriented design
• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment
• Experience with Agile or Waterfall development lifecycles
